paragraphs: Ibotta's mission is to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. We accomplish this mission by delivering digital promotions to consumers through the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). We source digital promotions from our clients, which are primarily consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands, and distribute these promotions to consumers via our network of publishers, which is enabled by our technology platform. We have strategic relationships with Walmart Inc. (Walmart), Dollar General Corporation (Dollar General), Family Dollar Stores, Inc. (Family Dollar), Maplebear, Inc. (Instacart), and DoorDash, Inc. (DoorDash), among others, who are third-party publishers on the IPN and use our content to power their digital offer programs on a white-label basis. We also host offers on Ibotta's direct-to-consumer properties, which include the Ibotta-branded cash back mobile app, website, and browser extension (collectively, direct-to-consumer (D2C), which is part of the IPN). Within D2C, we also partner with affiliate networks to access offers from certain retailer advertisers so consumers can earn cash back on a percentage of their total basket spend at those retailers.

In 2025, we introduced LiveLift™, a set of capabilities designed to help brands drive incremental sales at scale in a more cost-efficient manner. LiveLift™ enables more sophisticated projections and profitability metrics, including incremental sales and cost-per-incremental-dollar (CPID), to help our clients achieve the desired scale or efficiency for their promotions. We also have partnerships with Circana and ABCS Insights, which allow our clients to obtain third-party validation of the impact of their digital promotion campaigns via sales lift studies.

As of December 31, 2025, we worked with over 900 clients, representing over 3,100 CPG brands, to source exclusive digital offers. Most of our offers cover products in non-discretionary categories, such as grocery, but we also source offers for general merchandise categories, such as toys, clothing, beauty, electronics, pet, and home goods.

The IPN provides an at-scale success-based marketing solution whereby we get paid when our client's promotion results in a transaction with a consumer. By using the IPN, clients can create digital offers and distribute them in a coordinated fashion across our D2C properties and our third-party publishers.
The key components of the IPN are as follows:

Clients. Ibotta sources digital promotions from clients, retailers, and their media buying agencies. Each digital promotion is loaded into our network along with key parameters, such as the eligible products, total campaign budget, campaign expiration date (if any), and any criteria for distributing offers based on past purchase history, on platforms where available.

Publishers. We distribute our digital offers through our D2C properties and a growing network of third-party publishers that host our offers on their platforms on a white-label basis. We have formed strategic relationships with publishers such as Walmart, Dollar General, Family Dollar, Instacart, and DoorDash. On third-party publisher properties, consumers do not need an Ibotta account to redeem offers. We receive different amounts of data from different third-party publishers to enhance our tools and technologies.

Technology platform. Our platform, described in further detail below, tracks which offers are selected by consumers, matches offers to the products that have been purchased, logs redemptions, and manages budgets and billing. We use our technology platform to structure our clients' campaigns based on their objectives. Underpinning the platform is item-level consumer purchase data, which we use to process offer redemptions and help drive successful outcomes for our clients. We use AI/ML tools as part of our technology platform, and we continue to evaluate additional opportunities for applications of these tools as our platform evolves and as new AI/ML tools become available.

The above components of our network work together to create interconnected flywheels that can, over time, strengthen and accelerate the value of the IPN for our stakeholders. We believe that the network dynamics inherent in Ibotta's business create a strong competitive advantage. The more offers our clients sponsor, the greater value we can deliver to consumers, and the more likely that they continue to engage with our network. All else equal, over time, greater consumer engagement and larger audiences increase our chances of maximizing investments from both new and existing clients that are eager to influence the greater spending power of the millions of consumers reached by our network. The more offers that are redeemed on the IPN, the more redemption data we collect, and the better we become at structuring our clients' campaigns to maximize their investment.

At the same time, the more offers that we add, the more attractive joining our network becomes to new publishers, enlarging the total audience and attracting more client marketing investment. As the network grows, publishers are increasingly incentivized to integrate with our technology so they can incorporate our rewards into their own programs while allowing their consumers to redeem offers as seamlessly as possible.
We provide several products and offerings to our clients, retailers, publishers, and consumers through the IPN.
Our clients and retailers may purchase a combination of the following products to meet their marketing objectives.

We enable clients to deliver digital promotions to incentivize changes in consumer behavior and drive incremental sales. Through our deep experience with clients of various sizes that sell a wide range of

consumer products, we have developed curated, strategic "playbooks" that offer guidance on how best to achieve their specific marketing objectives. Depending on their goals, our clients can set an overall budget for their campaign then choose a set of eligible products, set offer values, and where possible, distribute different offers based on past purchase history.

paragraphs: Investing in our Class A common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, as well as the other information included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section titled, "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and our financial statements and related notes, before making an investment decision. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could materially adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects. In such an event, the market price of our Class A common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently deem immaterial also may impair our business operations and the market price of our Class A common stock.
Our business is subject to numerous risks and uncertainties. These risks include, but are not limited to, the following:
•We have a history of net losses, we anticipate increasing expenses in the future, and we may not be profitable.
•Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be materially adversely affected if we fail to maintain or grow offer supply and redemptions on our network.

•Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be materially adversely affected if we do not renew, maintain, and expand our relationships with clients or add new clients.

•Our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects could be materially adversely affected if we do not renew, maintain, and expand our relationships with existing publishers and add new publishers to the IPN, or if our publishers experience (as they have previously) downturns, store closures, or failures of their own businesses, or fail to adopt our additional offerings or fulfillment methods.

paragraphs: The following discussion and analysis of our financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with our financial statements and related notes included in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data to this Annual Report on Form 10-K. This discussion contains forward-looking statements, such as those relating to our plans, objectives, expectations, intentions, and beliefs, which involve risks and uncertainties. Our actual results could differ materially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements. Factors that could cause or contribute to such differences include, but are not limited to, those identified below and those discussed in the sections titled Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements and Risk Factors included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our historical results are not necessarily indicative of the results that may be expected for any period in the future.

The following discusses our financial condition and the results of operations as of and for the year ended December 31, 2025 compared to the year ended December 31, 2024. For a discussion of our financial condition and the results of operations as of and for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023, see "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of this Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, filed with the SEC on February 27, 2025, which is incorporated herein by reference.

On April 22, 2024, we closed our initial public offering (IPO), in which we issued and sold 2,500,000 shares of our Class A common stock at $88.00 per share. We received net proceeds of $198.0 million after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions of $13.2 million and offering costs of approximately $8.8 million.

Our business and results of operations are subject to global economic conditions. Our revenue depends on the ability of consumers to buy products that are featured on the IPN. Deteriorating macroeconomic conditions could lower promotional budgets and result in a decline in client spending, which could adversely affect the number of offer redemptions on our network. Management continues to actively monitor the impact of these macroeconomic factors on our financial condition, liquidity, operations, and workforce. For more information on risks associated with macroeconomic conditions, see the risk factor titled "Macroeconomic conditions, including slower growth or a recession and supply chain disruptions, have previously affected and could continue to adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations, and prospects."
Our current and future financial performance is primarily driven by the following factors:

Ability to add offer supply. Securing offers from clients is critical to the ongoing success of the IPN. We seek to grow the quantity and quality of offers on the IPN by deepening offer budgets and broadening offer parameters to include more qualifying products and fewer restrictions on offer distribution, consistent with the client's marketing objectives. These quantitative and qualitative dimensions of our offer inventory are highly correlated to our ability to attract and retain publishers and redeemers. We may also expand our offer inventory by continuing to penetrate general merchandise categories. We increase the quantity and quality of offers on the IPN through the efforts of our client-focused sales teams and business-to-business marketing.

Ability to grow our audience. Our relevance and value to clients depends on our ability to reach a growing audience of consumers who have the potential to become redeemers. Growing our consumer base, whether on our third-party publisher or D2C properties, depends on our ability to provide an attractive set of offers within our ecosystem and support seamless redemption experiences. Our ability to deliver offers at-scale will continue to depend on maintaining and growing redemptions at existing publishers and adding new publishers to the IPN. We have been able to foster and develop multi-year relationships with our retailer publishers, such as Walmart, Dollar General, Family Dollar, Instacart, and DoorDash. We intend to further grow our audience by growing redeemers at existing third-party publishers, adding new third-party publishers in retail and grocery, and expanding into new categories of publishers.

Ability to enhance the IPN through innovation. We will continue to invest in technology to further develop and accelerate the growth of the IPN for clients, retailers, publishers, and consumers. We have invested and expect to continue to invest in expanding our technologies, tools, and offerings to capitalize on new and unproven business opportunities.

For example, in 2025, we introduced LiveLift™, a set of capabilities that enables more sophisticated projections and profitability metrics, including incremental sales and CPID, to help our clients achieve the desired scale or efficiency for their promotions. We plan to continue rolling out LiveLift™ to our client base, allowing for increased frequency of campaign measurement and greater optimization capabilities. We plan to continue to use AI/ML to recommend and optimize campaign configurations rather than having our sales team manually set parameters with our clients. As the data generated from the IPN grows, we believe Ibotta will generate more valuable insights about purchase behavior and market trends, and will be able to further enhance our tools and technologies. We intend to enable clients to continue to leverage our AI/ML-powered tools to run success-based marketing programs that achieve our clients' goals. These investments and initiatives may negatively impact our short-term financial results.

Seasonality. Our results of operations vary from quarter to quarter, largely due to the seasonal nature of our clients' marketing spending. Our clients tend to devote a significant portion of their marketing budgets to the fourth quarter of the calendar year to coincide with consumer holiday spending and reduce their marketing budgets in the first quarter of the calendar year. At the same time, certain of

our clients' budgets may deplete over the course of the year. We have historically experienced heightened consumer activity during holidays, which resulted in higher redemptions on a relative basis. We typically see high redemption volume in the second half of the year where a larger number of offers being redeemed have lower redemption revenue per redemption. Although during the year ended December 31, 2025, we did not see the same seasonality we have historically seen, we expect seasonality may continue to impact our quarterly results going forward.

paragraphs: Ibotta 的使命為讓每一筆消費都具備回報。我們透過 Ibotta Performance Network (IPN) 來實現此使命，透過該平台將數位促銷活動提供給消費者。我們從客戶處取得數位促銷活動，這些客戶主要是消費者包裝商品 (CPG) 品牌，並透過我們的出版商網路將這些促銷活動分發給消費者，此網路由我們的技術平台所支撐。我們與 Walmart Inc. (Walmart)、Dollar General Corporation (Dollar General)、Family Dollar Stores, Inc. (Family Dollar)、Maplebear, Inc. (Instacart) 以及 DoorDash, Inc. (DoorDash) 等第三方出版商有戰略合作關係，這些出版商為 IPN 的成員，並使用我們的內容以白標方式運作其數位促銷活動。我們也於 Ibotta 的直營對消費者平台提供促銷活動，包括 Ibotta 品牌的現金回饋行動應用程式、網站及瀏覽器擴充功能（合稱為直營對消費者 (D2C)，為 IPN 的一部分）。在 D2C 中，我們也與聯屬行銷網路合作，以取得部分零售商廣告商的促銷活動，讓消費者能針對這些零售商的總購物金額中的一部分獲得現金回饋。
2025 年，我們推出了 LiveLift™，這是一組功能，旨在幫助品牌以更具成本效益的方式大規模推動增量銷售。LiveLift™ 使品牌能進行更精準的預測與獲利指標，包括增量銷售與每增量美元成本 (CPID)，以協助客戶達成其促銷活動所需的規模或效率。我們也與 Circana 和 ABCS Insights 有合作關係，這讓客戶能透過銷售提升研究，取得第三方對其數位促銷活動影響力的驗證。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們與超過 900 家客戶合作，代表超過 3,100 個 CPG 品牌，以取得獨家數位促銷活動。我們的促銷活動大多涵蓋非自願性消費類別的產品，例如食品雜貨，但也取得一般商品類別的促銷活動，例如玩具、服飾、美容、電子產品、寵物用品及家用品。
IPN 提供了一種規模化成功的行銷解決方案，我們在客戶的促銷活動導致消費者交易時獲得報酬。透過 IPN，客戶可以建立數位促銷活動，並透過我們的 D2C 平台及第三方出版商進行協調分發。
IPN 的關鍵零組件如下：
客戶。Ibotta 從客戶、零售商及其媒體買廣告代理商處取得數位促銷活動。每一個數位促銷活動會載入我們的網路，並搭配關鍵參數，例如合資格的產品、總活動預算、活動到期日（如有）、以及根據過去購買紀錄分發促銷活動的條件（如有）。

出版商。我們透過 D2C 平台及一個不斷成長的第三方出版商網路來分發數位促銷活動，這些出版商在其平台上以白標方式載入我們的促銷活動。我們與 Walmart、Dollar General、Family Dollar、Instacart 及 DoorDash 等出版商建立了戰略合作關係。在第三方出版商的平台上，消費者不需要 Ibotta 帳號即可兌換促銷活動。我們從不同的第三方出版商處取得不同數量的資料，以增強我們的工具與技術。
技術平台。我們的平台，後續將進一步說明，會追蹤消費者選擇的促銷活動、將促銷活動與已購買的產品進行匹配、記錄兌換紀錄，並管理預算與帳單。我們使用技術平台根據客戶的目標來規劃其促銷活動。支撐該平台的是商品層面的消費者購買資料，我們使用這些資料來處理促銷活動的兌換，並協助客戶達成成功的成果。我們在技術平台中使用 AI/ML 工具，並持續評估這些工具在平台進化及新 AI/ML 工具問世時的其他應用機會。

上述零組件共同運作，形成相互連結的飛輪效應，隨時間推移，可加強並加速智慧財產權網路（IPN）對我們利害關係人的價值。我們認為，Ibotta 事業的網路動態本質創造出強大的競爭優勢。我們的客戶提供的優惠越多，我們就能為消費者創造的價值越高，他們持續參與我們網路的機率也越高。其他條件相同的情況下，隨時間推移，更高的消費者參與度與更大的受眾羣，會增加我們實現來自新舊客戶的最大投資機會，這些客戶渴望影響數百萬消費者透過我們網路所具有的更大消費力。透過智慧財產權網路（IPN）兌換的優惠越多，我們所收集的兌換資料越多，我們就越能有效地規劃客戶的行銷活動，以實現他們的最大投資。
同時，我們增加的優惠越多，加入我們網路對新出版商的吸引力就越強，擴大總受眾羣並吸引更多的客戶行銷投資。隨著網路成長，出版商越來越有動機整合我們的技術，以便將我們的獎勵納入他們自己的計畫，同時讓其消費者能盡可能順暢地兌換優惠。
我們透過智慧財產權網路（IPN）為客戶、零售商、出版商和消費者提供多種產品與服務。
我們的客戶與零售商可能購買以下產品的組合，以達成其行銷目標。
我們協助客戶發送數位促銷活動，以激勵消費者行為的改變並推動增量銷售。透過我們與不同規模、銷售廣泛消費產品的客戶的深入經驗，我們已發展出經過策劃的、戰略性的「行動手冊」，提供如何達成其特定行銷目標的指導。根據其目標，客戶可以設定其行銷活動的總預算，然後選擇一組符合資格的產品、設定優惠金額，並在可能的情況下，根據過去的購買紀錄分發不同的優惠。
我們的客戶可以根據其目標設定行銷活動的總預算，然後選擇一組符合資格的產品、設定優惠金額，並在可能的情況下，根據過去的購買紀錄分發不同的優惠。

paragraphs: 以下對我們財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析，應與我們的財務報表及其相關附註，包含於本年度報告表 10-K 的第 8 項財務報表及補充資料中一併閱讀。此討論包含前瞻性陳述，例如與我們的計畫、目標、預期、意圖及信念相關的陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。我們的實際結果可能與這些前瞻性陳述所討論的結果有重大差異。導致此差異的因素包括，但不僅限於，以下所列及本年度報告表 10-K 其他部分標題為「特別注意前瞻性陳述與風險因素」的段落中所討論的風險因素。我們的歷史結果未必能代表未來任何期間的結果。

以下討論我們的財務狀況及營運成果，為 2025 年 12 月 31 日為止的年度，與 2024 年 12 月 31 日為止的年度比較。有關我們財務狀況及營運成果，為 2024 年 12 月 31 日為止的年度，與 2023 年 12 月 31 日為止的年度比較的討論，請參閱本年度報告表 10-K 中，財務年度為 2024 年 12 月 31 日的「管理層對財務狀況及營運成果的討論與分析」，於第二部分第 7 項，於 2025 年 2 月 27 日提交至 SEC，此部分已於 herein 並入參考。

Ibotta 的使命是讓每一筆消費都獲得回饋。我們透過 Ibotta Performance Network (IPN) 來實現此使命，將數位促銷方案提供給消費者。我們從客戶處取得數位促銷方案，這些客戶主要是消費者包裝商品 (CPG) 品牌，並透過我們的發行商網路將這些促銷方案分發給消費者，此網路由我們的科技平台所支撐。我們與 Walmart Inc. (Walmart)、Dollar General Corporation (Dollar General)、Family Dollar Stores, Inc. (Family Dollar)、Maplebear, Inc. (Instacart) 以及 DoorDash, Inc. (DoorDash) 等第三方發行商有戰略合作關係，這些發行商為 IPN 的成員，並使用我們的內容以白標方式運作其數位促銷方案。我們也於 Ibotta 的直營對消費者平台提供促銷方案，包括 Ibotta 品牌的現金回饋行動應用程式、網站及瀏覽器擴充功能（合稱為直營對消費者 (D2C)，為 IPN 的一部分）。在 D2C 中，我們也與聯屬網路合作，以取得某些零售商廣告商的促銷方案，使消費者能針對這些零售商的總購物金額中的一部分獲得現金回饋。
2025 年，我們推出了 LiveLift™，一組設計用以幫助品牌以更成本效益的方式大量推動銷售的技術能力。LiveLift™ 使更精準的預測與獲利指標，包括增量銷售與 CPID，協助我們的客戶實現其促銷活動所需的規模或效率。我們也與 Circana 和 ABCS Insights 有合作關係，使我們的客戶能透過銷售提升研究，取得第三方對其數位促銷活動影響的驗證。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，我們與超過 900 家客戶合作，代表超過 3,100 個 CPG 品牌，來取得獨家數位促銷方案。我們的大多數促銷方案涵蓋非必要性商品，例如食品雜貨，但我們也取得一般商品類別的促銷方案，例如玩具、服飾、美容、電子產品、寵物用品及居家用品。
於 2024 年 4 月 22 日，我們完成首次公開發行（IPO），發行並銷售 2,500,000  shares 的 Class A 普通股，每股價格為 88.00 美元。扣除經紀商折扣及佣金 13.2 百萬美元與發行費用約 8.8 百萬美元後，本公司取得淨資金 198.0 百萬美元。

我們的業務及營運成果受全球經濟條件影響。我們的營收取決於消費者購買 IPN 上所展示的商品的能力。總體經濟條件惡化可能降低促銷預算，導致客戶支出減少，進而對我們網路上的促銷兌換數量產生負面影響。管理層持續積極監測這些總體經濟因素對我們財務狀況、流動性、營運及員工的影響。如需有關總體經濟條件相關風險的更多資訊，請參閱標題為「總體經濟條件，包括較慢成長或經濟衰退及供應鏈中斷，已先前影響且可能繼續對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運成果及前景產生負面影響」的風險因素。
我們目前及未來的財務表現主要由以下因素驅動：

增加提供商品的能力。從客戶處取得提供商品是 IPN 維持持續成功的重要因素。我們致力於透過增加提供商品的數量與品質，來提升 IPN 上的提供商品，透過深化提供商品預算與擴展提供商品參數，以包含更多符合條件的商品與減少提供商品分發的限制，與客戶的行銷目標一致。這些提供商品庫存的數量與品質維度，與我們吸引並留住發行商與兌換者的能力建立高度相關。我們也可能透過持續深入一般商品類別來擴充我們的提供商品庫存。我們透過專注於客戶的銷售團隊與企業對企業行銷的努力，來增加 IPN 上的提供商品數量與品質。

擴大我們的受眾羣。我們對客戶的相關性與價值取決於我們能否接觸到越來越多有潛力成為兌換者的消費者。無論是在我們的第三方發行商或 D2C 資產上擴大我們的消費者基礎，都取決於我們能否在生態系統中提供一組有吸引力的提供商品，並支援順暢的兌換體驗。我們在大規模提供商品的交付能力，將持續取決於維持並擴大現有發行商的兌換量，並加入新的發行商至 IPN。我們已經能夠與零售商發行商，例如 Walmart、Dollar General、Family Dollar、Instacart 和 DoorDash，建立並發展多年期的關係。我們計畫透過在現有第三方發行商上擴大兌換者、加入零售與食品雜貨業的新第三方發行商，並擴展至新的發行商類別，進一步擴大我們的受眾羣。
透過創新來提升 IPN。我們將持續投資於技術，以進一步發展並加速 IPN 對客戶、零售商、發行商與消費者的成長。我們已經投資並預期會持續投資於擴展我們的技術、工具與服務，以把握新的與尚未驗證的商業機會。

例如，在 2025 年，我們推出了 LiveLift™，一組能提供更精確預測與獲利指標的能力，包括追加銷售與 CPID，以協助我們的客戶達成其促銷活動所需的規模或效率。我們計畫持續向客戶羣推出 LiveLift™，以增加活動測量的頻率與提升最佳化能力。我們計畫持續使用 AI/ML 來推薦與最佳化活動配置，而非讓銷售團隊手動設定參數與客戶。隨著 IPN 產生的資料持續增長，我們相信 Ibotta 將能產生更多關於購買新行為與市場趨勢的寶貴見解，並能進一步提升我們的工具與技術。我們意圖讓客戶能持續利用我們 AI/ML 驅動的工具執行以成功為導向的行銷活動，以達成客戶的目標。這些投資與計畫可能對我們的短期財務結果產生負面影響。

季節性。我們的營運結果會因季節性而每季有所不同，主要由於客戶的行銷支出具有季節性。客戶通常會在歷年第四季投入大量行銷預算，以配合消費者節日消費，並在歷年第一季減少行銷預算。同時，某些客戶的預算可能在一年內耗盡。我們歷來在節日時會看到較高的消費者活動，這導致相對較高的兌換量。我們通常會在一年的第二季看到較高的兌換量，其中較多的提供商品被兌換，但每兌換的兌換收入較低。儘管在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度中，我們並未看到與以往相同程度的季節性，我們預期季節性可能會持續影響我們的季度結果。
我們的客戶的預算可能在一年內耗盡。我們歷來在節日時會看到較高的消費者活動，這導致相對較高的兌換量。我們通常會在一年的第二季看到較高的兌換量，其中較多的提供商品被兌換，但每兌換的兌換收入較低。儘管在截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的會計年度中，我們並未看到與以往相同程度的季節性，我們預期季節性可能會持續影響我們的季度結果。

paragraphs: 投資本公司 A 級普通股涉及高度風險。您應謹慎考慮下列所列風險，以及本年度報告表 10-K 所包含的其他資訊，包括標題為「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」的章節，以及我們的財務報表與相關附註，再做投資決定。若發生下列任何事件或發展，可能會對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景造成重大不利影響。在這種情況下，本公司 A 級普通股的市場價格可能會下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉或認為不重要，也可能影響本公司業務運作與 A 級普通股的市場價格。
本公司業務面臨許多風險與不確定性。這些風險包括但不限於下列項目：
•本公司有淨虧損的歷史，預期未來費用將增加，且可能無法獲利。
•若本公司未能維持或擴大網路上的供應與贖回，則本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景可能受到重大不利影響。
•若本公司未能續約、維持並擴大與客戶的關係，或增加新客戶，則本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景可能受到重大不利影響。
•若本公司未能續約、維持並擴大與現有發行商的關係，或增加新發行商至 IPN，或若發行商經歷（如過去所發生）營運衰退、商店關閉或自身業務失敗，或未能採用本公司額外的產品或履行方式，則本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果與前景可能受到重大不利影響。
